scope: Texas veterans: TVC, VA medical centers & Vet Centers, Texas Veterans Network, SSVF housing, veteran employment

records.name: Veterans Benefits Claims Help
records.organization: Texas Veterans Commission
records.description_en: Free help from the state to file VA disability claims and appeals. They also help family members get survivor benefits.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas veterans and their dependents or survivors.
documents_needed: Medical records related to your claim
records.how_to_apply: Call the Texas Veterans Commission to find a claims counselor near you.
records.notes: Texas Veterans Portal lists TVC phones (800) 252-8387 and (512) 463-6564 and states TVC assists with VA disability claims, appeals, and survivor benefits. tvc.texas.gov blocked automated checks (Access Denied), so confidence is medium.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis del estado para presentar reclamos de discapacidad del VA y apelaciones. También ayudan a los familiares a recibir beneficios para sobrevivientes.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Veteranos de Texas y sus dependientes o sobrevivientes.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la Comisión de Veteranos de Texas para encontrar un consejero de reclamos cerca de usted.

records.name: Veterans Employment Services
records.organization: Texas Veterans Commission
records.description_en: Job help for veterans, such as job search support and connecting with employers who want to hire veterans.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Veterans looking for work in Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Visit your local Texas Workforce Solutions office and ask for veteran employment services, or register on WorkInTexas.com.
records.notes: Listed on the official Texas Veterans Portal; the TVC page (tvc.texas.gov/employment/) could not be read directly.
records.description_es: Ayuda de empleo para veteranos, como apoyo para buscar trabajo y conexión con empleadores que quieren contratar veteranos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Veteranos que buscan trabajo en Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a su oficina local de Workforce Solutions y pida los servicios de empleo para veteranos, o regístrese en WorkInTexas.com.

records.name: Fund for Veterans' Assistance (FVA) Grant Programs
records.organization: Texas Veterans Commission
records.description_en: A state fund that gives grants to local groups that help veterans. Grants pay for things like therapy, help to avoid homelessness, and meals for older or disabled veterans.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas veterans and their families. Each local grantee sets its own rules.
records.how_to_apply: The fund does not give money directly to people. Call 2-1-1 or the Texas Veterans Commission to find an FVA-funded group near you.
records.notes: Source page describes what FVA funds (therapy, housing help, hot meals). A current list of grantees was not accessible this session.
records.description_es: Un fondo del estado que da subvenciones a grupos locales que ayudan a veteranos. El dinero paga cosas como terapia, ayuda para no quedarse sin hogar y comidas para veteranos mayores o con discapacidad.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Veteranos de Texas y sus familias. Cada grupo local que recibe fondos tiene sus propias reglas.
records.how_to_apply_es: El fondo no da dinero directamente a las personas. Llame al 2-1-1 o a la Comisión de Veteranos de Texas para encontrar un grupo cerca de usted que recibe dinero del fondo.

records.name: Military Veteran Peer Network (MVPN)
records.organization: Texas Veterans Commission, Veterans Mental Health Department
records.description_en: Trained peer coordinators, who are veterans or family members themselves, offer support and connect people to mental health help. They work in local mental health centers across Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Any service member, veteran, or family member in Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Contact your local mental health authority and ask for the Military Veteran Peer Network coordinator.
records.notes: Program page veteransmentalhealth.texas.gov blocked automated checks; confirmed via the official Texas Veterans Portal.
records.description_es: Coordinadores capacitados, que también son veteranos o familiares de militares, ofrecen apoyo y lo conectan con ayuda de salud mental. Trabajan en centros locales de salud mental en todo Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier militar, veterano o familiar de militar en Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Comuníquese con el centro local de salud mental de su área y pida hablar con el coordinador de la Red de Apoyo entre Militares y Veteranos (MVPN).

records.name: Texas Veterans Network (TVN)
records.organization: Combined Arms (with Texas Workforce Commission)
records.description_en: A statewide network of over 300 groups that help veterans. You ask for help once and they connect you to the right services, usually within 72 hours.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Service members, veterans, military family members, Gold Star families, and caregivers in Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Sign up online on the Combined Arms portal or call to request help.
records.description_es: Una red en todo Texas con más de 300 grupos que ayudan a veteranos. Usted pide ayuda una sola vez y lo conectan con los servicios correctos, por lo general en 72 horas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Militares, veteranos, familias de militares, familias Gold Star (de militares que murieron en servicio) y cuidadores en Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Regístrese en línea en el portal de Combined Arms o llame para pedir ayuda.

records.name: Texas Veterans Leadership Program (TVLP)
records.organization: Texas Workforce Commission
records.description_en: A resource and referral program that helps returning veterans with jobs, training, and other needs.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Veterans returning from service, especially those who served in Iraq and Afghanistan.
records.how_to_apply: Call or email the TVLP office (tvlp@twc.texas.gov).
records.notes: TWC general line: (800) 628-5115. Texas Veterans Portal describes TVLP as serving returning veterans of Iraq and Afghanistan.
records.description_es: Un programa de recursos y referencias que ayuda a los veteranos que regresan del servicio con empleo, capacitación y otras necesidades.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Veteranos que regresan del servicio, sobre todo los que sirvieron en Irak y Afganistán.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un correo electrónico a la oficina de TVLP (tvlp@twc.texas.gov).

records.name: Veterans Crisis Line
records.organization: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs
records.description_en: Free, private crisis support by phone, text, or chat, any time of day or night.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Veterans, service members, National Guard and Reserve members, and the people who support them. You do not need to be enrolled in VA care.
records.how_to_apply: Dial 988 then press 1, text 838255, or chat online.
records.hours: 24/7, 365 days a year
records.notes: Text: 838255. Call 911 in an emergency.
records.description_es: Apoyo en crisis gratis y confidencial por teléfono, mensaje de texto o chat, a cualquier hora del día o de la noche.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Veteranos, militares, miembros de la Guardia Nacional y de la Reserva, y las personas que los apoyan. No necesita estar inscrito en la atención del VA.
records.how_to_apply_es: Marque 988 y luego oprima 1, mande un mensaje de texto al 838255 o use el chat en línea.

records.name: National Call Center for Homeless Veterans
records.organization: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs
records.description_en: Trained VA counselors answer calls and connect veterans who are homeless or about to lose housing to local help.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Veterans who are homeless or at risk of homelessness, and their family, friends, and service providers.
records.how_to_apply: Call the free hotline any time.
records.notes: Also written 1-877-4AID-VET.
records.description_es: Consejeros capacitados del VA contestan las llamadas y conectan con ayuda local a los veteranos que no tienen hogar o que están por perder su vivienda.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Veteranos que no tienen hogar o que corren riesgo de perderlo, y sus familiares, amigos y proveedores de servicios.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame gratis a la línea de ayuda a cualquier hora.

records.name: Veterans Housing Assistance Program (VHAP) Home Loans
records.organization: Texas General Land Office - Veterans Land Board
records.description_en: Low-interest home loans with little or no down payment to help Texas veterans and military members buy a home.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas residents age 18+ who are veterans (at least 90 active duty days, honorable/general/medical discharge), active duty, Texas National Guard, or qualifying reservists. The home must be your main home in Texas.
documents_needed: Certificate of Eligibility from the VLB
records.how_to_apply: Get a VLB Certificate of Eligibility, then apply through a VLB-participating lender.
records.hours: Monday - Friday 7:30am - 5:30pm
records.notes: Loans up to $832,750 per source; discounted rate for 30%+ service-connected disability. VLB does not refinance. Phone/hours from glo.texas.gov/veterans/contact-us/contact-veterans-land-board; email VLBinfo@glo.texas.gov.
records.description_es: Préstamos para casa con interés bajo y con poco o ningún pago inicial, para ayudar a veteranos y militares de Texas a comprar una casa.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes de Texas de 18 años o más que sean veteranos (con al menos 90 días de servicio activo y baja honorable, general o médica), militares en servicio activo, miembros de la Guardia Nacional de Texas o reservistas que califiquen. La casa debe ser su vivienda principal en Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Obtenga un Certificado de Elegibilidad del VLB y luego haga su solicitud con un prestamista que participe con el VLB.

records.name: Texas State Veterans Homes
records.organization: Texas General Land Office - Veterans Land Board
records.description_en: Affordable long-term nursing home care for veterans, their spouses, and Gold Star parents.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Qualified veterans, spouses, and Gold Star parents who meet medical, financial, and service rules. Veterans with a 70% or higher service-connected disability can generally live there for free.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the admission application on the Veterans Land Board website or call the VLB.
records.cost: Low cost; VA per diem helps; generally free for veterans rated 70%+ service-connected
records.notes: Phone is the VLB main line from the VLB contact page.
records.description_es: Cuidado a largo plazo en hogares de ancianos a precio accesible para veteranos, sus cónyuges y padres Gold Star (padres de militares que murieron en servicio).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Veteranos, cónyuges y padres Gold Star que cumplan con las reglas médicas, económicas y de servicio militar. Los veteranos con una discapacidad del 70% o más relacionada con el servicio por lo general pueden vivir allí gratis.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud de admisión en el sitio web del Veterans Land Board o llame al VLB.

records.name: Texas Lawyers for Texas Veterans (TLTV) Legal Clinics
records.organization: State Bar of Texas
records.description_en: Free civil legal advice clinics for veterans held around Texas with volunteer lawyers.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Veterans and their families who cannot afford a lawyer.
records.how_to_apply: Check the TLTV Legal Clinic Calendar on the State Bar website for a clinic near you.
records.notes: Civil (not criminal) legal help. Houston Bar Association holds weekly clinics at the Houston VA hospital. State Bar of Texas general contact listed on the page: (800) 204-2222.
records.description_es: Clínicas gratis de consejo legal civil para veteranos, con abogados voluntarios, en distintas partes de Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Veteranos y sus familias que no pueden pagar un abogado.
records.how_to_apply_es: Revise el calendario de clínicas legales de TLTV en el sitio web del State Bar para encontrar una clínica cerca de usted.

records.name: Veteran Readiness and Employment (VR&E, Chapter 31)
records.organization: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs
records.description_en: Helps veterans with service-connected disabilities get job training or education, find a new job, or start a business.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Service members and veterans with a service-connected disability that limits their ability to work.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at VA.gov.
records.notes: Phone is the VA benefits hotline.
records.description_es: Ayuda a veteranos con discapacidades relacionadas con el servicio militar a recibir capacitación o estudios, encontrar un nuevo trabajo o abrir un negocio.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Militares y veteranos con una discapacidad relacionada con el servicio que limita su capacidad de trabajar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga su solicitud en línea en VA.gov.

records.name: Houston VA Regional Benefit Office
records.organization: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Benefits Administration
records.description_en: In-person help with VA benefits like disability pay, pensions, education benefits, life insurance, and home loans.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Veterans, service members, and their families.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the office (appointments preferred through VERA) or call the VA benefits hotline.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.
records.notes: Phone is the national VA benefits hotline. Source page: some services are walk-in, but appointments through VERA (va.my.site.com/VAVERA) are preferred. Bring a current photo ID.
records.description_es: Ayuda en persona con beneficios del VA, como pagos por discapacidad, pensiones, beneficios de educación, seguro de vida y préstamos para casa.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Veteranos, militares y sus familias.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a la oficina (es mejor hacer cita por VERA) o llame a la línea de beneficios del VA.

records.name: Waco VA Regional Benefit Office
records.organization: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Benefits Administration
records.description_en: In-person help with VA benefits like disability pay, pensions, education benefits, life insurance, and home loans.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Veterans, service members, and their families.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the office (most services are walk-in, or book an appointment through VERA) or call the VA benefits hotline.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
records.notes: Phone is the national VA benefits hotline. Source page says most services are walk-in; appointments can be booked through VERA (va.my.site.com/VAVERA).
records.description_es: Ayuda en persona con beneficios del VA, como pagos por discapacidad, pensiones, beneficios de educación, seguro de vida y préstamos para casa.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Veteranos, militares y sus familias.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a la oficina (la mayoría de los servicios son sin cita, o puede hacer cita por VERA) o llame a la línea de beneficios del VA.

records.organization: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs - VA Central Texas Health Care
records.description_en: VA health care for veterans, including primary care, specialty care, and mental health care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Veterans enrolled in (or eligible for) VA health care.
records.how_to_apply: Apply for VA health care online at VA.gov or call the facility.
records.hours: Open 24/7 (hours vary by clinic/service)
records.cost: Free or low copay based on eligibility
records.notes: Serves veterans from the surrounding region; any enrolled veteran may use it. VA health connect line: (833) 284-7212. Mental health line: (254) 778-4811.
records.description_es: Atención médica del VA para veteranos, incluyendo atención primaria, especialistas y salud mental.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Veteranos inscritos en la atención médica del VA (o que califican para ella).
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite la atención médica del VA en línea en VA.gov o llame al centro médico.

records.name: Austin Vet Center
records.organization: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs - Vet Centers (Readjustment Counseling)
records.description_en: Free, private counseling for eligible veterans, service members, and families, including help after combat, military sexual trauma, and grief.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Eligible veterans, service members (including National Guard and Reserve), and their families. Call to check if you qualify.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Vet Center to set up a visit.
records.hours: Mon 8:00 a.m.-4:30 p.m.; Tue 8:00 a.m.-4:30 p.m.; Wed 8:00 a.m.-4:30 p.m.; Thu 8:00 a.m.-4:30 p.m.; Fri 8:00 a.m.-4:30 p.m.; Sat-Sun closed. Some non-traditional hours; call to ask.
records.notes: Vet Center Call Center: (877) 927-8387 (vetcenter.va.gov). Serves the surrounding region, not only the listed county. Hours from va.gov; the center also offers some non-traditional hours that change, so call first.
records.description_es: Consejería gratis y confidencial para veteranos, militares y familias que califican, incluyendo ayuda después del combate, por trauma sexual militar y por duelo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Veteranos, militares (incluyendo la Guardia Nacional y la Reserva) y sus familias que califiquen. Llame para saber si usted califica.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al Vet Center para hacer una cita.

records.how_to_apply: Call the SSVF intake line to be screened.
records.notes: Alternate intake phone: 254-634-1184 x116. Grantee listed on the VA FY2026 SSVF Provider Intake List (grant 12-TX-071).
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de veteranos que no tienen hogar o que están por perder su casa. Puede incluir un encargado de caso, ayuda para encontrar vivienda y ayuda por poco tiempo con gastos como la renta o los depósitos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Hogares de veteranos de bajos ingresos que no tienen hogar o que corren riesgo de perderlo, en los condados que atienden.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de admisión de SSVF para que revisen si usted califica.
